description: The hospitals that file a payer across all codes, optionally in one state, paginated: plan_count, payer_rate_rows and filed_rate_count per hospital. Includes total_count. For one payer's rates for a specific code use list_code_payer_hospitals. Backed by the hospital-prices serving snapshot; fails with UNAVAILABLE until the server has opened one.

page_token.description: Opaque next_page_token from a previous response; only valid with the same request fields.

payer_slug.description: A payer_slug from list_payers or list_code_payers, e.g. "aetna".

state.description: Optional two-letter USPS state code (e.g. "TX", case-insensitive): only hospitals with a location in that state are counted. A hospital in several states counts in each, so state figures can add up to more than national ones. Empty means every hospital; anything that is not a state code is rejected as INVALID_ARGUMENT.

name: list_payer_hospitals
title: List the hospitals that file a payer
